hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Khorasan Arabic, an Arabic island in Khorasan that diverged from the Mesopotamian (Iraqi) dialects prior to the so-called qeltu/gelet split (and thus to the immigrations during the ninth and tenth centuries) is not intelligible to its relatives, and is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:s:Seeger:Araber-Chorasan**, **hh:s:Dahlgren:Arabkhane**).
